data.name: The Last Endure: Dungeon Escape
data.detailed_description:
Step into The Last Endure, a brutal roguelike dungeon crawler where every mistake is costly and every victory feels earned.

Choose your heroes

  • Build a party of exactly three heroes – no more, no less.

  • Mix and match classes to unlock powerful synergy perks: Tank + Healer, Rogue + Mage, and many more.

  • Experiment with different line-ups until you find the squad that survives the longest.

Face ruthless enemies and lethal traps

  • Battle enemy types that inflict nasty status effects: Freeze, Fear, Toxic and chaotic red slimes, each demanding a different answer.

  • Navigate a dungeon filled with spikes, spinning blades, crumbling floors and lava pits. There are many ways to die, and the dungeon is happy to show you all of them.

Panic, retreat, learn, repeat

Every encounter is a small puzzle of positioning, timing and resource management. Sometimes the smartest move is to pull back, regroup and try again with a different approach – or a different team.

Potions, loot and Ancient Coins

  • Stock up on health, defense and special potions. You will never feel like you have enough of them.

  • Discover Ancient Coins, a rare premium currency that can be obtained through in-game purchases and used to unlock powerful heroes and extra resources.

Keys, portals and the real objective

Your true goal is simple:
Collect scattered keys, activate the hidden portal and escape the dungeon – if you dare.
Whether you make it out or die trying, every run teaches you something new and pushes you to go one room further next time.

In-game purchases and optional boosts

  • Purchase Ancient Coins to unlock strong heroes, potion bundles and extra options for difficult runs.

  • Optional rewarded systems allow you to gain bonus potions or extra retries without affecting core progression for players who prefer a pure challenge.

Why you will keep coming back

  • Permadeath with progression – death resets the run but not what you have learned.

  • Smart encounter and trap design that forces you to adapt instead of memorising.

  • High replayability thanks to different hero combinations, perks, trap layouts and enemy mixes.

Good luck… you will need it.
Download The Last Endure and prove you can survive the dungeon’s ultimate test.

data.short_description: A brutal roguelike dungeon crawler where you lead a squad of three heroes through deadly traps and status-inflicting monsters. Build synergies, stack potions and Ancient Coins, and try to escape the dungeon before it consumes you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

Recommended:

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
